summary: ATHLERA V1: 36/36 backend pytest cases passed and end-to-end mobile UI flow verified (opening → auth register → onboarding sports → per-sport rating (accredited + level) → summary → dashboard → +Score record match → preview projection → confirm submit → match recorded). Guest flow also passes: continue-as-guest → onboard → dashboard → preview OK but submit properly blocked with in-UI notice 'Guests can preview but not submit verified matches'. Score validation edge cases verified for all 5 sports (squash 11-10 invalid / 12-10 valid, badminton 30-29 valid / 31-29 invalid, tennis+padel 6-4 & 7-6 valid / 6-5 invalid, pickleball 11-10 invalid). UAS returned in 0-1000 range. Auto-verify against seed opponents updates ratings & rating_history. Logout revokes JWT. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) present.

issues: React Native web warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — non-blocking but should be migrated for future RN Web compatibility.

action_items: (Non-blocking) Migrate deprecated RN Web style props: replace shadow{Color,Offset,Opacity,Radius} with boxShadow and props.pointerEvents with style.pointerEvents to silence console warnings.

(Optional) Consider seeding the Score screen with an initial 2-game layout for BO3 sports so users don't need to tap '+ ADD GAME' before entering a valid squash/badminton match (UX only — logic is correct).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: all endpoints under /api prefix, MongoDB _id excluded via projection, env vars used, HTTPExceptions with proper codes; rating math and score validators are cleanly isolated and unit-testable — good.
server.py:832 match_submit re-runs match_preview which itself validates score & fetches player_sports twice (once here, once in preview). Minor perf duplication but harmless for V1.
auth/logout returns 204 even without a bearer header — acceptable but could 401 for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Created ~5 fresh test users via /api/auth/register and multiple matches auto-verified against seed opponents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_athlera_api.py (run with `-n 0` since pytest.ini forces xdist loadscope but tests share session-scoped fixtures). Frontend testIDs are well-scoped: opening-screen, logo-enter-button, auth-screen, tab-signup/signin, input-{email,password,display-name}, auth-primary-submit, auth-continue-guest, onboarding-sports-screen, sport-card-{id}, onboarding-continue-btn, onboarding-rating-screen, accredited-{yes|no}-{sport}, provider-{sport}-{name}, rating-value-{sport}, level-{sport}-{lvl}, onboarding-submit-btn, onboarding-summary-screen, summary-enter-btn, dashboard-screen, uas-hero, sport-card-{id}, score-screen (opened via tapping center of bottom tab bar at ~y=810 — no direct data-testid on the FAB itself, so use page.mouse.click), pick-sport-{id}, pick-opponent-{uid}, add-game-btn, game-a-{i}/game-b-{i}, preview-rating-btn, confirm-submit-btn, match-submitted, new-match-btn.
rca_of_issue: No bugs to RCA — V1 spec functionality is intact.
